mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous 2 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% over the previous quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 3% over the previous 3 months signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decreases by more than 0.25% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable or decreases over the previous 2 months, it signals a dovish monetary policy stance without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL stable or decrease
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% and CPIAUCSL remains stable or decreases.
